survey: A round wall clock seen almost straight on, against a flat striped green wall. Parts: a thick orange torus rim; a white dial set slightly inside it; 12 navy hour markers and a ring of minute dots around the dial; hour, minute and red second hands joined at a central navy hub with a red cap. The rim and dial are concentric circles with matching roundness, and the hub sits at the dial's centre. The hour markers point straight at the centre and are evenly spaced, with 12/6 and 3/9 lined up on the axes. The dot ring follows the dial edge evenly. The soft shadow on the wall to the lower right agrees with a clock hanging flat on a wall seen face-on. The wall stripes stay vertical and parallel. One frontal camera throughout.
